title: When a Vape Shop May Have Retailer and Manufacturer Responsibilities
searchIntent: Explain the U.S. FDA's public distinction between retail activity and actions that may create manufacturer responsibilities.
sourceName: U.S. FDA — Pipe, Cigar, and Vape Shops that Are Regulated as Both Retailers and Manufacturers
sourceFacts: FDA states that a shop which mixes e-liquids, makes or modifies vaporizers, or mixes loose tobacco and sells the products may be regulated as both a retailer and manufacturer.
A shop that sells products but does not conduct those activities may be considered a tobacco retailer.
The page links to FDA guidance and describes responsibilities as role-dependent.
jurisdictionBoundary: Discuss U.S. FDA public information only; state that actual classification and obligations depend on facts and applicable rules, and are not decided by this article.
prohibitedClaims: Do not state that any activity is automatically compliant or noncompliant.
